evidence: Modifies src/test/bip32_tests.cpp to test the ParseHDKeypath and FormatHDKeypath utilities in src/util/bip32.cpp.
rationale: Improves unit test coverage for ParseHDKeypath by validating parsed vector values and round-trip formatting rather than merely checking boolean return status. The author showed the test suite previously had a blind spot where an 'obviously broken implementation' such as inserting keypath.clear() before return true would still pass. While worthwhile to protect parser correctness, it addresses no active production bug and is reasonably deferrable.
